title.value: A Group Symmetric Stochastic Differential Equation Model for Molecule Multi-modal Pretraining
title.justification: This title accurately captures the core methodology presented in the paper, which focuses on molecule multi-modal pretraining using a group symmetric stochastic differential equation model.
title.quote: A Group Symmetric Stochastic Differential Equation Model for Molecule Multi-modal Pretraining

extractions.description: The paper introduces MoleculeSDE, a group symmetric stochastic differential equation model for molecule multi-modal pretraining. It aims to improve AI-based drug discovery by leveraging both 2D topological graphs and 3D geometric point clouds in molecule representation. The model maximizes mutual information between these modalities to enhance molecular representation capabilities and outperform existing methods in various downstream tasks.
